classes.definition: Evidence obtained without executing the capability on a real host: schema validation, structural invariants, compile/import boundaries, DAG and ownership checks.
mayClaim: a contract, disposition or ownership fact is ratified
a structural invariant holds on the reviewed artifacts
mayNotClaim: executed behavior on any host or profile
performance, latency, allocation or RSS results

classes.definition: Evidence from real execution on a named host/profile with the ProductReceiptBasis bound: source revisions, project/configuration, engine and host identity, completeness state.
mayClaim: observed behavior with its exact host, profile and engine identity
reproducible scenario outcomes under the receipt basis

classes.definition: Projected or extrapolated numbers not obtained on the required workload under the ratified performance methodology.
mayClaim: a labelled estimate, explicitly marked as such
mayNotClaim: speedup or resource figures presented as measured

claimLaws: A support claim for a framework, extension or profile requires runtime observation from that item's own producing train terminal; a static proof (architecture proof, installed parser, syntax highlighting) never satisfies it (WDX0-AC2).
An estimate is never promotable to a completion, conformance, source-revision, speedup or supported-version claim.
Qualifying an upstream feature as Verter support requires the owned authored integration and public operation evidence; pinning or installing upstream alone is static proof at best.
Negative, partial, conditional and unsupported results are truthful states, not routes for hiding unfinished required scope.

historicalCompletions.authority: authority/state/implemented.toml (the implementation ledger stays the sole completion truth; this constitution adds no second status store)
historicalCompletions.statement: Every implemented-ledger completion keeps its standing. This constitution ratifies the added portfolio on top of history; it reopens, downgrades or deletes nothing. The added portfolio starts with zero completions and zero advertised catalog surfaces.

anchors.outcome: SFC TypeScript projection constitution and current-feature contract
